systems.platform: Laxton biometric registration kits and fingerprint scanners; database infrastructure by IN Groupe
systems.owner: Government of Madagascar, under the World Bank-funded PRODIGY project
systems.tiers: mass enrolment with nearly 2,500 multimodal kits; 2.6 million enrolled in two months against a target of two million

note: Identity enrolment only; civil registration appears only as a commentator's remark on a retroactive legal framework.
